name: David Giuntoli
knownFor: Grimm, A Million Little Things, 13 Hours
bio: David Giuntoli is best known to genre fans as Detective Nick Burkhardt, the central character of NBC's supernatural series Grimm. He later starred as Eddie Saville in ABC's A Million Little Things, and his film credits include 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi.

name: Silas Weir Mitchell
knownFor: Grimm, Prison Break, My Name Is Earl, 24
bio: Silas Weir Mitchell is widely recognized for his fan-favorite turn as Monroe on Grimm and for playing Charles 'Haywire' Patoshik on Prison Break. His long television and film career also includes My Name Is Earl, 24 and Rat Race.

name: Bree Turner
knownFor: Grimm, Bring It On Again, Deuce Bigalow: Male Gigolo, Law & Order: SVU
bio: Bree Turner is best known as the warm and resourceful Fuchsbau Rosalee Calvert on Grimm. Her credits also include Bring It On Again, Deuce Bigalow: Male Gigolo, The Ugly Truth, Just My Luck, American Pie 2 and Law & Order: Special Victims Unit.

name: Sasha Roiz
bio: Sasha Roiz is best known as Captain Sean Renard on Grimm. He also played Sam Adama in Caprica and has appeared in series including Suits, Chicago Med, 9-1-1 and Tracker.

name: Reggie Lee
knownFor: Grimm, Prison Break, The Fast and the Furious, The Dark Knight Rises
bio: Reggie Lee is best known as Sergeant Drew Wu on Grimm. His screen credits also include Prison Break, All Rise, The Lincoln Lawyer, The Fast and the Furious, Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End and The Dark Knight Rises.

name: Claire Coffee
knownFor: Grimm, General Hospital, The West Wing, FBI
bio: Claire Coffee is best known for playing Adalind Schade on Grimm. Her television work also includes General Hospital, The West Wing, Franklin & Bash, Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector and FBI.

name: Judith Hoag
knownFor: Halloweentown, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Armageddon
bio: Judith Hoag is beloved as Gwen Cromwell Piper in the Halloweentown films and as April O'Neil in the original 1990 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles movie. Her credits also include Nashville, Big Love, The Magicians and Armageddon.

name: Kimberly J. Brown
knownFor: Halloweentown, Guiding Light, Stephen King's Rose Red
bio: Kimberly J. Brown is best known as Marnie Piper in Disney Channel's Halloweentown film series. Her credits also include Guiding Light, Stephen King's Rose Red, Tumbleweeds, Quints and Bringing Down the House.

name: Daniel Kountz
knownFor: Halloweentown II: Kalabar's Revenge, God of War Ragnarök
bio: Daniel Kountz is best known for playing Kal in Halloweentown II: Kalabar's Revenge. His credits include Mad Men, Ghost Whisperer, United States of Tara, ER, Fifteen and Pregnant and voice work in God of War Ragnarök.

name: David Mazouz
knownFor: Gotham, Touch, The Office, Criminal Minds
bio: David Mazouz is best known for portraying a young Bruce Wayne on FOX's Gotham. He starred opposite Kiefer Sutherland in Touch and appeared on The Office as Bert California and Criminal Minds as Ryan Hall. His credits also include Major Crimes, The Darkness and Incarnate.

name: Robin Lord Taylor
knownFor: Gotham, The Walking Dead, Accepted, John Wick: Chapter 3
bio: Robin Lord Taylor is best known for his five-season performance as Oswald Cobblepot, the Penguin, on FOX's Gotham. He also appeared in Netflix's You as Will Bettelheim, along with The Walking Dead, Accepted, John Wick: Chapter 3 and Law & Order.

name: Rachelle Lefevre
knownFor: Under the Dome, Twilight, A Gifted Man, Boston Legal
bio: Rachelle Lefevre is best known for starring as investigative journalist Julia Shumway in CBS's Under the Dome, based on Stephen King's novel. She also played Victoria in the first two Twilight films and has appeared in Proven Innocent, A Gifted Man and Boston Legal.

name: Mike Vogel
knownFor: Under the Dome, Cloverfield, The Texas Chainsaw Massacre, Bates Motel, The Brave
bio: Mike Vogel starred as Dale 'Barbie' Barbara throughout all three seasons of CBS's Under the Dome. His film and television work also includes Cloverfield, The Help, The Texas Chainsaw Massacre, Poseidon, Bates Motel and The Brave.

name: Wildefell Wolves
character: Leshen, Astarion and Ori the Wolves • Eivor the Owl
bio: Wildefell Wolves are visiting from Eastern Tennessee as ambassadors for wildlife education, photography and cinema. Their featured animal guests include Leshen, Astarion and Ori the wolves, along with Eivor the owl.

name: Samurai Jill
character: Professional cosplayer, convention host and content creator
bio: Pittsburgh-based Samurai Jill is a professional cosplayer, convention host and content creator who began focusing on cosplay in 2017. Her work spans Marvel, DC, Star Wars, Jurassic World and other fandoms, and she has been published in outlets including Cosplay Zine, Cosplay Alliance Magazine and The Jurassic Mag.
